name: Bokutachi wa Benkyou ga Dekinai Visual Novel (Fan-Game)
source:
A fan-game adaptation of the work "We Never Learn" (Bokutachi wa Benkyou ga Dekinai).
You will have to make different decisions that will lead you to 5 endings. Can you win their hearts?
translation:
根据《我们无法一起学习》（ぼくたちは勉強ができない）改编的同人游戏。
你需要作出不同的选择，走向5种结局。你能赢得她们的芳心吗？
